import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static final int[] dx = {-1, 0, 1, 0};
    static final int[] dy = {0, 1, 0, -1};
    static final int INF = 1 << 30;
    static int n, t;
    static char[][] gr = new char[21][21];
    static char[][] gr2 = new char[21][21];
    static int[][] inds = new int[21][21];
    static int[][] inds2 = new int[21][21];
    static int[][] mk = new int[21][21];
    static int[][] c = new int[21][21];
    static int rp, cp;
    static int in;
    static int S = 202, T = 203;
    static int V;
    static List<Edge>[] graph;
    static int[] level;
    static int[] ptr;

    static class Edge {
        int to, rev, cap;
        Edge(int t, int r, int c) {
            to = t;
            rev = r;
            cap = c;
        }
    }

    static void addEdge(int from, int to, int cap) {
        graph[from].add(new Edge(to, graph[to].size(), cap));
        graph[to].add(new Edge(from, graph[from].size() - 1, 0));
    }

    static boolean bfs(int s, int t) {
        Arrays.fill(level, -1);
        level[s] = 0;
        Queue<Integer> q = new LinkedList<>();
        q.add(s);
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int v = q.poll();
            for (Edge e : graph[v]) {
                if (e.cap > 0 && level[e.to] < 0) {
                    level[e.to] = level[v] + 1;
                    q.add(e.to);
                }
            }
        }
        return level[t] >= 0;
    }

    static int dfs(int v, int t, int flow) {
        if (v == t) return flow;
        for (; ptr[v] < graph[v].size(); ptr[v]++) {
            Edge e = graph[v].get(ptr[v]);
            if (e.cap > 0 && level[v] + 1 == level[e.to]) {
                int pushed = dfs(e.to, t, Math.min(flow, e.cap));
                if (pushed > 0) {
                    e.cap -= pushed;
                    graph[e.to].get(e.rev).cap += pushed;
                    return pushed;
                }
            }
        }
        return 0;
    }

    static int maxFlow(int s, int t) {
        int flow = 0;
        while (bfs(s, t)) {
            Arrays.fill(ptr, 0);
            while (true) {
                int pushed = dfs(s, t, INF);
                if (pushed == 0) break;
                flow += pushed;
            }
        }
        return flow;
    }

    static boolean valid(int a, int b) {
        return a >= 0 && a < n && b >= 0 && b < n;
    }

    static void busc(int a, int b) {
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) Arrays.fill(mk[i], 0);
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) Arrays.fill(c[i], -1);
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++)
                if (gr[i][j] == 'Y') mk[i][j] = 1;

        Queue<int[]> q = new LinkedList<>();
        q.add(new int[]{rp, cp});
        q.add(new int[]{a, b});
        c[a][b] = 0;
        c[rp][cp] = 0;
        mk[a][b] = 1;
        mk[rp][cp] = 2;

        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int[] cur = q.poll();
            int nx = cur[0], ny = cur[1];
            if (mk[nx][ny] == 1 && gr2[nx][ny] > '0' && gr2[nx][ny] <= '9') {
                addEdge(inds[a][b], inds2[nx][ny], 9);
            }
            if (mk[nx][ny] == 1 && c[nx][ny] == t) {
                continue;
            }
            for (int d = 0; d < 4; d++) {
                int nx2 = nx + dx[d], ny2 = ny + dy[d];
                if (valid(nx2, ny2) && mk[nx2][ny2] == 0) {
                    mk[nx2][ny2] = mk[nx][ny];
                    c[nx2][ny2] = c[nx][ny] + 1;
                    q.add(new int[]{nx2, ny2});
                } else if (mk[nx][ny] == 1 && valid(nx2, ny2) && mk[nx2][ny2] == 2 && c[nx2][ny2] == c[nx][ny] + 1 && gr2[nx2][ny2] > '0' && gr2[nx2][ny2] <= '9') {
                    addEdge(inds[a][b], inds2[nx2][ny2], 9);
                }
            }
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        n = sc.nextInt();
        t = sc.nextInt();
        sc.nextLine(); // consume newline

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            String line = sc.nextLine();
            gr[i] = line.toCharArray();
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            String line = sc.nextLine();
            gr2[i] = line.toCharArray();
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < 21; i++) {
            Arrays.fill(inds[i], -1);
            Arrays.fill(inds2[i], -1);
        }
        in = 0;
        rp = cp = -1;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                char ch = gr[i][j];
                if (ch > '0' && ch <= '9') {
                    inds[i][j] = in++;
                } else if (ch == 'Z') {
                    rp = i;
                    cp = j;
                }
            }
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                char ch = gr2[i][j];
                if (ch > '0' && ch <= '9') {
                    inds2[i][j] = in++;
                }
            }
        }

        int maxNode = Math.max(in, Math.max(S, T));
        V = maxNode + 1;
        graph = new ArrayList[V];
        for (int i = 0; i < V; i++) graph[i] = new ArrayList<>();
        level = new int[V];
        ptr = new int[V];

        // edges from source to gr digits
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (inds[i][j] != -1) {
                    addEdge(S, inds[i][j], gr[i][j] - '0');
                }
            }
        }
        // edges from gr2 digits to sink
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (inds2[i][j] != -1) {
                    addEdge(inds2[i][j], T, gr2[i][j] - '0');
                }
            }
        }
        // direct edge if both grids have digits
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (inds[i][j] != -1 && inds2[i][j] != -1) {
                    addEdge(inds[i][j], inds2[i][j], 9);
                }
            }
        }
        // BFS edges
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (inds[i][j] != -1) {
                    busc(i, j);
                }
            }
        }

        int result = maxFlow(S, T);
        System.out.println(result);
        sc.close();
    }
}
